source_text.body:
Prepare bulk social posts for Buffer or Metricool
A commenter has Claude write captions and a CSV for bulk scheduling in Buffer or Metricool, since it can't post to Instagram or TikTok directly.
·
Nov 21, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
A commenter said they use Claude for the planning layer rather than direct posting: it writes captions, and in one suggested setup it also prepares a CSV for bulk upload into Buffer or Metricool. The person still reviews everything before scheduling, because Claude cannot post to Instagram or TikTok by itself without an approved app or scheduler connected to those platforms' APIs.
How it went
The thread presents this as the easiest workable path for batching posts, but gives no performance numbers or case-study results. The main limitation stated is that posting still depends on external approved tools, and manual review is recommended to catch bad captions before anything goes live.
Worth knowing
The key catch is that Claude alone cannot publish to Instagram or TikTok; you need Buffer, Metricool, or another approved scheduler/app to do the actual posting.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
I'm promoting [brand or product] to [audience] on [Instagram/TikTok/both]. Write [20] social captions with hashtags in a [tone] voice, built around [themes or products], and put them in a CSV with columns for date, time, platform, caption, and media filename, spaced out over [number] weeks. It's finished when the CSV matches the bulk upload format for [Buffer/Metricool] and I've reviewed the captions before importing.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1y1ef25/automatic_uploading_to_instagram_tiktok
